Minoan harbor town cascades down terraced slopes to azure water. White plaster buildings with red columns catch Mediterranean sun. Dolphin frescoes adorn walls facing the sea. Merchant ships with painted sails crowd stone quays.

Mesopotamian marsh village rises on reed platforms above still water. Mudhif houses woven from bundled reeds line narrow channels. Dugout canoes glide between dwellings. Fish dry on racks while water buffalo wade through shallows.

Phoenician Tyre fortress-city stands on its island, connected to mainland by causeway. Waves crash against massive stone breakwaters. Purple-dye vats line the shore, staining waters violet. Cedar warships anchor in protected harbors.

Nile temple during inundation season. Sacred lake mirrors painted pylons perfectly. Floodwaters lap at limestone steps carved with hieroglyphs. Lotus flowers choke processional waterways between monuments. Priests pole reed boats through temple courtyards.

Heian period Japanese coastal shrine built over tidal shallows. Vermilion torii gate stands in salt water. Wooden walkways on stilts connect buildings. Fishing boats pass beneath shrine platform at high tide, leaving offerings.

Moche adobe platform mounds rise beside Pacific coast. Reed boats with upturned prows float in surf. Fishermen carry nets along beach. Sea fog shrouds pyramids each morning, revealing polychrome friezes as sun burns through.

Bronze Age crannog settlement on Scottish loch. Circular thatched houses perch on wooden platforms over dark water. Smoke rises from stone hearths. Mountains reflect perfectly in still surface. Dugout canoes moored to oak pilings.

Srivijayan harbor city on Sumatran coast. Wooden stilt houses extend over shallow bay. Monsoon rains hammer palm-thatch roofs. Buddhist stupa rises on artificial island connected by bridges. Trading vessels from India shelter in protected anchorage.

Achaemenid Persian quarry workers load limestone blocks onto river barges. Cedar logs lashed together float downstream toward Persepolis construction sites. Wooden cranes pivot on stone quays. Workers chant while guiding massive stones aboard.

Aksumite Red Sea port with stone-built warehouses facing turquoise water. Incense smoke drifts from merchant ships. Ge'ez inscriptions mark harbor walls. African and Arabian dhows crowd granite piers, unloading ivory and gold.

Viking-age Norse shipyard on fjord shore. Clinker-built longships rest on log rollers. Oak planks steam over fires for bending. Carved dragon-prow reflects in glassy water. Mountains rise steeply behind boathouses.

Early Polynesian Lapita settlement on coral atoll. Outrigger canoes beached on white sand. Thatched houses on low stilts over lagoon. Navigation stones mark safe channels through reef. Pottery shards litter tide pools.

Shang Dynasty oracle bone diviners work beside Yellow River's edge. Bronze ritual vessels reflect in muddy water. Rammed-earth platforms rise above flood plain. Turtle shells dry on reed mats. Dugout canoes ferry grain tribute upstream.

Tiwanaku raised-field agriculture surrounds Lake Titicaca. Stone-lined channels carry water between planted beds. Totora reed boats with bundled hulls glide past sandstone piers. Snow-capped Andes mirror in sacred lake. Fishermen check woven traps.

Etruscan rock-cut tombs honeycomb coastal cliffs above Tyrrhenian Sea. Waves crash against tufa stone. Painted burial chambers visible through carved doorways. Fishing boats shelter in sea caves below. Seabirds nest in ancient funeral niches.

Carthaginian circular harbor with central island platform. Limestone shipsheds house two hundred war galleys. Seawater fills dredged basins. Purple-sailed merchant vessels wait outside military port. North African sun glints off bronze-sheathed rams.

Classic Maya cenote shrine in Yucatan limestone. Jade offerings glitter in clear spring water. Carved stelae surround natural well. Priests descend steep stone steps. Tree roots grip rocky walls above sacred pool reflecting jungle canopy.

Nubian fortress island in Nile cataract. Granite walls rise from churning water. Mudbrick barracks perch on bedrock. Papyrus skiffs navigate between black boulders. Kushite archers watch from towers as river foams around fortifications.

Scythian timber-built fortress on Dnieper River island. Log palisades reflect in slow current. Felt-covered yurts cluster inside wooden walls. Horse-hide boats ferry warriors across. Steppe grasslands stretch beyond marshy banks and willow groves.

Olmec stone heads gaze across Gulf Coast lagoon. Basalt colossi transported by raft from distant mountains. Mangrove roots grip ceremonial platform edges. Dugout canoes glide through brackish channels. Tropical rain drums on thatch shelters.

Champa brick temple towers rise from Mekong Delta ricefield. Monsoon floodwaters surround sanctuary island. Sanskrit inscriptions mark sandstone lintels. Reed boats pole between submerged causeways. Water buffalo graze on exposed banks at low water.

Pictish broch tower stands on tidal island off Scottish coast. Drystone walls taper upward from bedrock. Causeway disappears twice daily beneath cold sea. Smoke escapes through capstone opening. Seals haul out on surrounding skerries at dawn.

Han Dynasty salt workers evaporate seawater in coastal pans. Bamboo pipelines carry brine to ceramic evaporation dishes. Wooden waterwheels lift water from tidal pools. Workers rake white crystals. Flat-bottomed junks load salt sacks at pier.

Pre-contact Hawaiian heiau temple platform faces Pacific surf. Lava-rock walls enclose wooden oracle tower. Offerings rest on stone altar. Outrigger canoes ride incoming swells. Coconut palms bend in trade winds above black sand beach.

Khmer Angkor Wat temple complex during monsoon flooding. Sandstone causeway submerged beneath rising water. Lotus pools merge with moat surrounding central towers. Apsara carvings reflect in still water. Saffron-robed monks wade through courtyards carrying palm-leaf manuscripts.
